apps.title: Halloween Art Color
apps.summary:
Jack-o’-lanterns flicker, witches soar across the moon, and ghosts peek from haunted windows—bring the magic of Halloween night to life, one color at a time.
Halloween Art Color combines a relaxing paint by number game with the charm of a Halloween-themed adult coloring book. Follow the numbers, tap to fill each area, and watch uncolored outlines become vibrant Halloween pictures.
🖌️ Easy to Play, Satisfying to Complete
No drawing experience needed. Choose a picture and let the numbers guide you.
- Follow the numbers: match each color to its numbered areas.
- Tap to fill: bring color to each space with simple taps.
- Skip the brushwork: no sketching, color mixing, or careful tracing required.
- Watch the transformation: see every detail come together as you complete your picture.
🎃 Color Up Your Halloween World
From cute and playful to dark and mysterious, explore coloring pages filled with seasonal charm.
- Pumpkin glow: jack-o’-lanterns, autumn pumpkin fields, and festive displays.
- Witchy magic: witches, spell books, and bubbling potions.
- Spooky encounters: ghosts, vampires, skeletons, and mischievous monsters.
- Mysterious creatures: black cats, bats, ravens, and magical companions.
- Moonlit scenes: haunted houses, Gothic castles, graveyards, and shadowy forests.
- Trick-or-treat fun: costumes, candy, happy Halloween parties, and colorful decorations.
Pick a playful ghost for a cheerful coloring moment, or explore the intricate details of a mysterious castle. Every picture reveals a different side of Halloween.
🕯️ A Little Spooky. A Lot of Relaxation.
Take a quiet coloring break in a world of Halloween magic. Enjoy a few taps between daily tasks or settle into the details of a favorite scene.
If you enjoy casual games, Gothic illustrations, or cozy seasonal art, this color by number experience offers a simple way to unwind. Find your own moment of zen in the gentle rhythm of filling each space, and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing your picture come together.
Download Halloween Art Color, light the jack-o’-lanterns, and awaken the magic beyond the haunted windows—one color at a time!

Chess is one of the oldest and most popular board games in the world. Playing chess can be an enjoyable way to sharpen your mind, enhance strategic thinking, and engage in stimulating problem-solving.

Whether you're a complete beginner or an experienced grandmaster, Chess is designed for all skill levels and all ages. Enjoy smooth controls, stunning 3D visuals, and intelligent AI to train your brain and enjoy the free and unlimited chess game — with no Wifi needed.

Say goodbye to cold chessboards — our game blends beautiful design with deep strategy. apps.title: Pixel Gun 2
apps.summary:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — of old rules, map architecture, traditional loadouts and more!

Short matches. Destructible arenas. Wild builds. Non-stop FPS action. Ever-evolving world. A piece of controlled mayhem that fits in your pocket — or takes over your evening. Jump in for a few PvP battles or lose track of time (with no regrets).

Experiment with loadouts, improvise in ever-changing environments, embrace the chaos, and make the most out of the reality-bending Pixelstorm!

EVERY MATCH HITS DIFFERENT
Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The battle arena starts falling apart with every shot fired. Creative builds clash, throwing surprises at everyone involved.

As the PvP match goes on, you evolve too — stacking perks, adapting on the fly, and leaning into whatever the situation demands. Will you end up a life-stealing headshot machine, a melee juggernaut, a speed-running gadgeteer — or something nobody saw coming?

Next time it will be different. And that’s the point.

WRECK HAVOC. MAKE A MESS

apps.title: Frolf Fest: Arcade Disc Golf
apps.summary:
Throw. Compete. Collect.

Frolf Fest is arcade disc golf in your pocket. Fun for both disc golf experts and those new to the sport.

Throw:

Pick your line, time your tempo, and watch the disc turn and fade down the fairway. Thread through tight tree gaps, throw long bombs, finesse touchy approaches, and drain long range putts. Test yourself across a variety of demanding courses, with real wind and weather mechanics.

Compete:

Play duel matches against real players, challenge your friends to a round, or sharpen your skills against challenging bot rivals across a variety of game modes.

Collect:

Every disc flies differently. There are many ways to conquer the course - find your own game. Earn unique and exclusive disc molds, trails, finishes, stamps, bags, and avatar customizations as you play through the game.

Share:

Share highlights and wild shots with friends! See the best long-range hole-outs, unfortunate tree kicks, and incredible aces from the community.

Play:

7+ challenging, hand authored courses across a variety of unique biomes. Multiple game modes, from casual solo rounds and fun competitions with friends, to frantic tournaments and tough ranked duels against real rivals.

Throw far. Compete hard. Collect it all.

- Throw - authentic disc flight with turn, fade, and impactful wind and weather across varying terrain and times of day.

- Compete - real opponent duels in stroke, skins, and stableford formats, friend challenges, leaderboards, and multi-round tournaments.

- Collect - unique and exclusive discs, trails, finishes, stamps, bags, customizations.

- Share - replay and save memorable shots to share with friends.

- Arcade fun - the satisfaction of realistic disc golf flight paired with fast-paced arcade gameplay.

- Good gaming - controller / gamepad support, offline play, and cloud saves available.

- Frolf Fest is a game that respects you - no ads for anyone, ever. The game contains no subscriptions. If you choose, you can join the Pro Club with a single, one-time purchase to unlock all Frolf Fest has to offer and support game development.

apps.title: MapTap.gg
apps.summary:
MapTap is a daily geography game. Every day you get five places tied to real events from that exact date, and the game is to find each one on a 3D globe. Tap where you think it is. The closer you land, the higher you score. Then you read what actually happened there: a shipwreck, an invention that failed twice before it worked, a border that moved overnight, someone nobody has heard of who changed something you use every day.

It takes about 2 minutes to play. Tomorrow there are five more, and five more the day after that. Keep a streak alive, see how your score sits against everyone else who played that day, or just against players near you. When 2 minutes is not enough, there is a lot more globe. Practice maps run from plain drills to journeys you retrace one stop at a time: Magellan's expedition, Darwin's voyage on the Beagle, Nellie Bly's race around the world, Ibn Battuta's travels. Find the Flag is a daily of its own. Gauntlet is a timed run at a set of locations everybody gets on the same day. Frontier is a survival run where one bad guess ends it. Versus puts you head to head with another player over five locations, with a rating that follows you around. Flashcards drill a map until it sticks.

There are hundreds of achievements to discover. You can build maps for other players, and play other players' maps!

MapTap plays in 12 languages. MapTap+ is an optional subscription that adds sharper satellite detail on the globe, the full run of practice maps, private groups to play alongside friends, the last 90 days of games you missed, drill sets you build yourself, and the curated Best of MapTap collection.

The daily game is free, and there are no ads in it anywhere, for anyone, ever.

apps.summary:
In the Bubble Vocab word game, your brain meets a fresh word jam challenge. Drag matching words or picture bubbles together, group them by category, and watch jam words vanish in a satisfying pop. Every move counts for solving each bubble word jam puzzle within the move limit to conquer each word association puzzle. Can you think fast enough to solve and clear bubbles before you run out of moves?

Gameplay of Bubble Vocab:
Spot the connection and word association. Each jam word belongs to a hidden association category such as words and images that share a common bubble merge theme. Slide and drag them across the board to unite all four matching bubbles in the same association group. When all categories are cleared, you win the word bubble pop level.

Bubble Vocab isn't just a bubble pop or bubble merge game. It's a bubble word jam that tests your ability to see association between ideas, images and language. Think carefully, drag jam word precisely, and clear the word bubble merge board with as few moves as possible.

Features of Bubble Vocab:
📚 Satisfying bubble merge mechanic: drag matching bubbles together and watch categories disappear in a clean, rewarding word bubble pop.
🔤 Word and picture challenges: our word game combines visual and language thinking. So every bubble word jam puzzle feels distinct.
🎯 Step-limited puzzles: every level gives you a fixed number of moves; plan ahead to clear all association categories and complete the jam word challenge.
🧩 Association-based categories: bubbles are grouped by meaning, theme, or visual similarity; sharpen your word bubble pop instincts to spot the links.
💡 Clean and intuitive drag controls: swipe bubbles into position with simple gestures; no complicated menus, just pure puzzle-solving.

Bubble Vocab is not just a crossword, word association game or a simple word game; it is a category-matching bubble word jam unlike any word game you’ve played before. Ready to drag, merge, and conquer? Jump into the game and put your association skills to the test!

apps.title: Boom Crush: 3D Blast Fun
apps.summary:
Welcome to Boom Crush, a cheerful casual game with physics puzzle action. Aim a cannon at unstable towers and watch blocks, crates, and cans move, bounce, and fall in a 3D arena.

Choose a level, inspect the stack, set your cannon angle, and shoot at the weak point. A careful cannon shot can crush a support, trigger a blast, and send the tower into a chain reaction.

Physics Puzzle Challenges

Every physics puzzle has a different layout. Light blocks slide easily, while heavy pieces hold the stack. A low cannon shot may crush the base; a higher cannon shot may reach a protected block. Watch how the first blast changes the physics puzzle before choosing your next cannon move.

Cannon, Crush, and Blast Action

Tap to aim, adjust the cannon, and shoot. A direct cannon shot may smash one block, while a planned cannon launch can create a wider blast. Look for gaps and weak supports.

Objects tip, bounce, break, and crush into one another. A small blast can shift a stack, while a side blast can push a block toward another target. A central blast may open a path for a second crush. Every smash changes the scene. Watch the first smash, plan the next smash, and use a final smash when the stack is ready. One crush can lead to another crush, while a careful blast can prepare the next blast.

One smash can move a block; a second smash can start a blast. Watch the smash before the next smash and adjust your shot.

Colorful Stacks and Simple Controls

Boom Crush uses familiar objects in casual game levels. One physics puzzle may use boxes and crates; another physics puzzle combines cans, jars, and rubber ducks. Use the cannon to move a key block, then let gravity continue the crush. A careful smash can remove one support, while a wider blast can clear a row.

The controls are easy for casual players, but each physics puzzle rewards observation. Replay a level to test another cannon position, compare a low shot with a high shot, and find a cleaner route. An angle change can create a new blast path. If the first smash leaves a block standing, adjust the cannon and try again.

Relaxing Casual Games

Play a quick round or continue through more casual games. Watch the tower lean as pieces smash, slide, and settle. Every crush matters, and each cannon shot can change the result.

For another physics puzzle, adjust the cannon angle. A short cannon shot may crush one block, while a longer cannon launch can start a blast. Let the first crush settle, then choose a second blast or smash. The right cannon move can connect the next crush and smash.

In a physics puzzle, a careful blast can shift the base before a second blast reaches the upper stack. One crush can open a path, one smash can move a block, and another smash can finish the layout. Study the target, plan the blast, and choose the next cannon action.

Can you solve every physics puzzle, manage your cannon shots, and use each blast wisely? Aim at the weak block, start the crush, and enjoy this casual game.

Bendy's Nightmare Run is back!

Run as Bendy, Boris, or Alice in a nightmare-fueled endless runner where the goal is simple: survive the chase and defeat crazy cartoon bosses.

RUN FROM TROUBLE

Dash through four themed episodes filled with enemies, obstacles, collectibles, weapons, and powerups. Swipe left and right to move, swipe up to jump or double jump, and swipe down to slam onto enemies as you race away from increasingly difficult bosses.

Collect Bacon Soup and XP as you run, and use your rewards to unlock characters, levels, weapons, costumes, and powerful upgrades.

Every level puts you in a chase against a unique cartoon boss. Collect weapons during your run to throw them back at that big, bad bully. Dodge attacks, manage your health, use powerups, and defeat the boss before it defeats you.

FOUR NIGHTMARISH EPISODES

Explore four original environments, each with its own boss:

• Bendy in Treasure Trouble — Dash across sandy islands, wooden docks, and pirate ships while Chester the treasure chest chases you through the tropics.

• Bendy in Death and Taxis — Race through city streets and tunnels to escape Gaskette, a taxi cab with a death wish ... yours.

• Bendy in Soup Gone Bad — Fight your way through a smelly trash dump while sharp-edged Canoodle tries to cut you down to size.

• Bendy in Dewey Decimated — Crash through a not-so-quiet library, along bookshelves and across tabletops, while inky Dewey tries to spear you with his pointy pen.

Keep running and try to defeat the boss again and again, pushing your score higher until the nightmare finally consumes you.

COMPLETE OBJECTIVES

Each level includes objectives that challenge you to master your run. Collect Bacon Soup, defeat bosses without taking damage, and complete other objectives as you work towards unlocking all the good stuff.

MORE CARTOON CRAZINESS TO COME!

Get ready for endless mode, player profiles, leaderboards, new costumes, seasonal events, new episodes, new bosses and more!

A CARTOONY NIGHTMARE IN THE BENDY UNIVERSE

Bendy's Nightmare Run returns with its distinctive cartoon-themed runner gameplay, featuring Bendy, Boris, and Alice alongside original bosses and environments created specifically for Bendy's Nightmare Run.

apps.summary:
Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort is a relaxing puzzle with a fresh conveyor twist, blending colorful sorting, smart crate filling, and smooth loop-based logic into a calm but satisfying experience.

🎮 In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, you sort colorful cubes and cards into matching crates in a relaxing conveyor loop puzzle with no timers and no rush. Just pure color sort gameplay that clears your mind while you clear the board. If you love sorting games with unique conveyor mechanics and cozy puzzle vibes, this is your perfect match.

🌀 Sorting in Motion

This is more than a simple color sort. The loop keeps everything moving, so timing, order, and space management matter just as much as matching the right colors.

🏆 One Conveyor Loop, One Goal

In Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort, every move is about keeping the conveyor flowing, matching colors efficiently, and making smart use of limited space.

• Tap to send cubes onto the conveyor and set the loop in motion.
• As cubes travel around the belt, they wait for the right crate to open up.
• Gather four cubes of the same color in one crate to combine them into a complete piece.

Keep the Loop Clear

• Watch the conveyor capacity carefully, because only a limited number of cube groups can stay on the loop at once.
• If the conveyor fills up and no useful moves remain, the round comes to an end.
• Every open slot can change your next move, so keeping space available is part of the puzzle itself.
• In some levels, only the top color is visible at first, while the cubes below stay hidden until they are revealed one by one.
• This hidden-color twist makes every early move more important, because one choice can affect which colors appear next.

Plan your moves, control the flow, and enjoy the satisfaction of every perfect merge.

⚡ Tools to Keep the Loop Moving

When the conveyor gets crowded, the right tool can help you fix mistakes, reopen space, and keep your sorting plan alive.

• Undo – Take the card on the conveyor back to the box and undo your last move. It’s perfect for correcting a rushed decision before it causes bigger problems.

• Shuffle – Select a plank and shuffle the color cubes inside. Use it to reset a tricky arrangement and open up new matching possibilities.

• Extra – Add 2 more capacity slots when you need more room. It gives you valuable breathing space when the loop gets tight and every open spot matters.

🎁 More Levels, More Rewards

Every completed level gives you something to look forward to. Win more levels to earn rewards, collect level gifts, and unlock limited-time perks like 30-minute unlimited lives that let you keep playing with fewer interruptions.

👍 Why You’ll Love It

• A fresh conveyor loop twist that makes every sort feel more dynamic.
• Clean, low-randomness puzzle play where smart planning pays off.
• Great for a quick break, with enough depth to keep longer sessions rewarding.
• Offline-friendly gameplay that fits wherever you want to play.
• A great match for fans of color sorting, card puzzles, and calm brain games.

Ready to clear the loop and master the flow? Start Loop Master™: Color Jam Sort now and enjoy a fresh sorting puzzle built around calm strategy and satisfying progress.

Clear the Loop. Match the Card. Sort the Cube.

Mahjong Tiles - Win Real Money

Your Peaceful Escape, Now with Real Rewards

Imagine a place where the gentle strum of a guzheng soothes your mind, lanterns glow softly in a twilight garden, and each tap of a tile brings you closer to both clarity and cash. That place is Mahjong Tiles - Win Real Money—a game designed not just to entertain, but to reward your focus, patience, and strategic thinking.

Why Mahjong Tiles?

Because we believe relaxation shouldn't be empty, and rewards shouldn't come with stress. We've taken the beloved classic of Mahjong solitaire and elevated it into a serene, ad-free experience where every move counts—literally. The better you play, the more you earn. No gimmicks, no interruptions, just pure tile-matching bliss with tangible outcomes.

How It Works

Match to Win: Clear the board by pairing identical, uncovered tiles. Each successful match is a step forward—not just in the game, but toward real money rewards.

Plan Your Strategy: Unlike luck-based games, Mahjong Tiles rewards foresight. Think ahead, unlock combos, and maximize your payouts with smart sequencing.

Play at Your Pace: Short on time? Five minutes is all you need for a quick session. Have a quiet evening? Dive into deeper levels with increasingly intricate layouts.

A Visual and Auditory Sanctuary

We've poured care into every pixel and note. The art style draws from classical East Asian aesthetics—think ink-wash landscapes, jade-like tile textures, and flowing bamboo animations. The soundtrack blends ambient nature sounds with traditional instrumentals, creating a space that feels like a meditative garden rather than a typical mobile game. No flashing neon, no jarring pop-ups—just you, the tiles, and the quiet satisfaction of a board well cleared.

More Than a Game—A Mindful Practice

Mahjong has long been cherished for its cognitive benefits. It sharpens memory, enhances pattern recognition, and trains logical reasoning. With Mahjong Tiles, you're not just passing time—you're exercising your brain while building a rewarding habit. And when that reward becomes real money, the motivation only grows stronger.

What Players Love

Zero Ads: We mean it. No banner ads, no video interruptions, no pop-ups. Your focus stays where it belongs—on the game.

Fair & Transparent: Clear rules, clear earning mechanics. You'll always know how rewards are calculated.

Beautifully Crafted: From the tile carvings to the ambient breeze effects, every detail is designed for immersion.

Progressively Challenging: As you advance, layouts become more complex, keeping your mind engaged and your skills evolving.

Join the Journey Today

Mahjong Tiles - Win Real Money isn't just another puzzle game. It's a daily ritual of calm, a test of wits, and a genuine opportunity to turn your leisure time into something valuable. Download now and discover how good it feels when peace of mind comes with a reward.

apps.title: Last Shelter: War Z
apps.summary:
The last bastion of humanity has fallen. As the Commander of a final group of survivors, you face a grim new world in the aftermath of doomsday. You hid in an abandoned underground shelter. You must venture into the unknown, reclaim the wasteland, and eradicate the zombie horde. Build your underground stronghold, but remember: survival demands more than walls—it requires expansion, exploration, and relentless combat.​

【BUILD YOUR SURVIVAL SHELTER】
Your underground fortress is the heart of your resistance. Build and customize every room—from Power Generators and Research Labs to Control Centers. Upgrade your facilities to unlock advanced weapons. Design your layout with tactical strategy, because this isn't just a home, it's a war base that fuels your fight to reclaim the world.

【EXPLORE & COLLECT UNDERGROUND】
The real adventure lies in the darkness. Send elite squads into unexplored tunnels and the desolate wastelands shown on your map. Scavenge for vital resources, uncover lost technology, and undertake critical missions to rescue other survivors and search for a cure​ under the zombie horde. Every expedition is a high-stakes mission: stay vigilant—zombies lurk everywhere, and danger strikes without warning.

【FIGHT ZOMBIES】
Combat is brutal and constant. Face off against zombie swarms, terrifying mutant bosses, and other enemy threats lurking in the shadows. Assemble a team of unique heroes, master their powerful abilities, and devise tactical formations to crush your enemies in intense battle. Engage in clashes where you must shoot, fight with guns, and survive enemy fire.

【BASE DEFENSE & TOWER TACTICS】
Your shelter is a prize coveted by all. Defend it from waves of zombies and raids from rival commanders! Construct defensive fortifications, lay cunning traps, and strategically place guard towers to create an impenetrable fortress. Use your radar to detect incoming enemy​ hordes and plan your strategy.

【FORM ALLIANCES FOR DOMINANCE​】
Forge powerful alliances with other players to conquer the wasteland together. Coordinate attacks, share resources, and participate in large-scale alliance wars to dominate the ruined cityscapes. Victory in this endless war belongs to those who unite.

Last Shelter: War Z offers a rich, strategic survival experience with a focus on exploration, combat, and cooperation. The apocalypse was the end of the world, but this is the start of yours. Will you lead humanity to rebirth? Download now and begin your underground odyssey!

apps.title: Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble
apps.summary:
Can you clear the bus stop before traffic grinds to a halt?

Welcome to Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble, a colorful puzzle game where every move matters. Guide passengers through crowded pathways, match them with the correct buses, and keep the line moving without creating a traffic disaster.

What starts as a simple boarding task quickly turns into a satisfying puzzle challenge. Riders block one another, new colors appear, hidden passengers are revealed, and every level requires careful planning to avoid getting stuck.

How to Play
Tap passengers to send them toward the boarding area.
Match riders with buses of the correct color.
Fill each bus and dispatch it to free up space.
Plan ahead to prevent blocked paths and traffic jams.
Complete increasingly challenging levels filled with new obstacles.
Features

🚌 Easy-to-learn passenger sorting gameplay

🎯 Hundreds of handcrafted puzzle challenges

🔍 Hidden passengers and surprise level mechanics

🧩 Strategic decisions that reward smart planning

⚡ Helpful boosters when a level gets crowded

🎨 Unlock new themes and bus stop designs

🌟 Bright visuals and smooth animations

Whether you're looking for a quick brain teaser or a longer puzzle session, Bus Jam: Traffic Trouble offers a relaxing yet rewarding experience packed with satisfying passenger-sorting puzzles.

apps.title: Highway Heroes: Truck Manager
apps.summary:
🚚 Highway Heroes is the truck tycoon management game where strategy beats speed. Build a freight company from the ground up, plan smart routes across U.S. regions, and grow your idle tycoon empire through careful decisions — not quick reflexes. If you love a logistics game that rewards patience and planning, welcome home.

🗺️ Start with one garage and a single rig in this truck tycoon adventure. Line up hauling contracts, choose the best routes for profit and efficiency, and deliver on time to build your reputation. Every dollar earned is a decision made — reinvest in your fleet, expand your facilities, or unlock new regions. With idle tycoon earnings working for you around the clock, your company never stops growing.

🏗️ Build the infrastructure behind your logistics game empire. Add garages, service bays, and dispatch offices that directly improve turnaround time, driver reliability, and contract access. Every upgrade in this management game reshapes how your business operates — faster maintenance, smarter logistics, and bigger contracts within reach.

🎨 Customize your fleet down to the details in this truck tycoon. Choose authentic paint schemes, decals, lighting rigs, trailers, and performance parts. Clean isometric views and tidy menus make every choice easy to read and satisfying to make — even on smaller screens. The idle tycoon system lets your customized trucks earn while you plan your next move.

📦 Master the logistics game at the heart of Highway Heroes. Match the right loads to the right trucks, schedule around weather and distance, and keep fuel costs and repairs under control. Managing contracts in this truck tycoon feels like running a real business: orderly, fair, and deeply satisfying.

🛻 Collect iconic American haulers in this management game. From classic rigs to modern workhorses, each truck unlocks new routes and contract types. This is a logistics game where your collection has real strategic value — not just cosmetic appeal. Every truck you add strengthens your fleet with new cargo options and better efficiency across regions.

👀 See everything at a glance. Crisp isometric angles, clear icons, and legible text make complex decisions feel simple. Whether you're a veteran truck tycoon player or new to this kind of management game, Highway Heroes is designed for clarity over clutter. The idle tycoon mechanics keep your company running smoothly, so you can check in on your terms.

🇺🇸 Begin in the United States and expand region by region. Hire dependable drivers, upgrade your headquarters, and become a true trucking mogul. With idle tycoon earnings funding your growth, a deep logistics game driving every decision, and a management game built for thinkers — this truck tycoon is the road to take.

apps.title: AI Dungeon Master & RPG Fablia
apps.summary:
Fablia is an AI Dungeon Master that runs a fantasy RPG built around you. No group to schedule, no rulebook to memorise, no waiting for anyone else. Describe what your hero does, and the AI narrates what happens next.

A DUNGEON MASTER THAT NEVER RUNS OUT OF STORY
Type any action and the AI Dungeon Master answers it. Talk your way past the gate guards, torch the tavern, spare the bandit who begged, or walk away from the whole quest. The story bends around your choice and remembers what you did. No two runs tell the same tale, because nothing is scripted.

THREE WAYS TO BEGIN YOUR QUEST
• Quick Start — drop into an adventure in seconds
• Forge — a guided RPG character creator. Choose your age and origin, take the skills your past earned you, then spend your stat points
• Sandbox — no rules, no rails. Write your own world, set its laws, seed the people who matter, and tell the Dungeon Master exactly how to run it

ROLL THE DICE AND LIVE WITH IT
Skill checks are settled the tabletop way, with a real D20 roll rendered in 3D with sound and haptics. Beat the target and you stay on your feet. Miss it and fortune turns against you. Push your luck too far and you are rolling a death save.

YOUR HERO, YOUR RECORD
• Character sheet tracking stats, skills and gear
• Codex that fills in with the lore, people and places you uncover
• Chronicle of every scene in your campaign
• Multiple save slots, so several adventures can run side by side

BE ANYONE, WITH NO LIMITS
Play the knight who keeps their oath or the one who breaks it. Be a scheming merchant, a hedge witch, a deserter, a god-touched fool. The AI roleplay adapts to the character you actually write, not a class you picked from a list.

WHY PLAYERS PICK FABLIA
• A solo RPG you can play in five minutes or five hours
• Interactive fiction with real consequences, not a branching menu
• A text adventure where you type freely instead of tapping preset replies
• A choose your own adventure engine that never repeats itself
• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

WHAT YOU CAN DO
Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Build a hero from nothing and watch the world start reacting to your name. Or throw all of it out and build a world of your own in Sandbox, down to how the Dungeon Master should narrate it.

Fablia is for anyone who loves fantasy RPG storytelling, interactive story games, AI roleplay, dungeon master simulators, text adventures and classic tabletop roleplaying, but wants it available the moment the mood strikes.

Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.

• Tabletop-style dungeon crawling without needing a party

Explore ruined keeps and drowned shrines. Bargain, bluff and threaten your way through encounters. Recruit companions and lose them. Your world is unwritten. Begin your quest.
